text.content: Setting the scene

rich_text.plain_text: Setting the scene

text.content: Contigo GmbH's loan status tool has been running in internal testing for two weeks without incident. Then, during a scheduled maintenance window, the core banking API goes offline. The tool begins returning a generic 503 error on every call. The agent receives the error, reasons that it has not yet fulfilled the client's request, and calls the tool again. The tool returns another 503. The agent tries again. And again. Within four minutes, the agent has made sixty-three consecutive tool calls against a downed API, consumed a significant portion of the sprint's token budget, and produced no response to the client.

rich_text.plain_text: Contigo GmbH's loan status tool has been running in internal testing for two weeks without incident. Then, during a scheduled maintenance window, the core banking API goes offline. The tool begins returning a generic 503 error on every call. The agent receives the error, reasons that it has not yet fulfilled the client's request, and calls the tool again. The tool returns another 503. The agent tries again. And again. Within four minutes, the agent has made sixty-three consecutive tool calls against a downed API, consumed a significant portion of the sprint's token budget, and produced no response to the client.

text.content: The problem is the agent has no instruction for what to do when those tools fail. Its system prompt tells it to retrieve the loan status before responding. The tool keeps failing. The agent keeps trying. Nothing in the architecture tells it to stop.

rich_text.plain_text: The problem is the agent has no instruction for what to do when those tools fail. Its system prompt tells it to retrieve the loan status before responding. The tool keeps failing. The agent keeps trying. Nothing in the architecture tells it to stop.

text.content: This failure mode is one of the most operationally dangerous risks in production agent deployment. It is also entirely preventable with two targeted interventions: a deterministic iteration cap and an explicit fallback protocol.

text.content: Why language model instructions alone are insufficient

rich_text.plain_text: Why language model instructions alone are insufficient

text.content: The instinctive response to this failure is to add a system prompt instruction: "if the tool fails, stop trying and apologise to the client." This is necessary but not sufficient.

rich_text.plain_text: The instinctive response to this failure is to add a system prompt instruction: "if the tool fails, stop trying and apologise to the client." This is necessary but not sufficient.

text.content: Language models are probabilistic. An instruction to stop after a failure will reduce the frequency of looping. Under certain conditions, with certain query phrasings, or after a specific sequence of tool outputs, the model may reason its way past the instruction and retry the tool anyway. Probabilistic compliance is not an acceptable safety standard for a production system handling client-facing financial workflows.
